mapper.select: SELECT u.*, r.role_code, r.role_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE u.username = #{username} AND u.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.real_name, u.phone, u.email, u.avatar, u.gender, u.user_type, u.school_id, u.status, u.remark, u.create_time, s.school_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN school s ON u.school_id = s.id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.deleted = 0

SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND p.permission_code IS NOT NULL AND p.permission_code != ''
